text:
Mira Chen: Quick sync — Marigold preview cohort A kickoff. Need final consent + telemetry opt-in from all seats by EOD Friday. I want a single checklist so we don't miss renewals.
Alex P: Do we have a consent email template? can reuse the standard preview template? @Mira Chen
Mira Chen: Yes — using the preview template but with extra telemetry clause. Link: https://docs.redwood.com/cs/marigold-consent (draft) please review.
Jas: SSO question — are we requiring SAML for this cohort or allowing token-based SSO? a few customers can't do SAML yet.
Mira Chen: Allow token-based for now but flag those accounts (tag: no-saml) — we'll prioritize SAML before GA.
Samir: Heads up — if telemetry isn't opt-in'ed they won't feed quality signals; that increases our renewal risk. recommend 15-min office hours next Tues to show value.
Dena: I can run an enablement office hour. Need slides + 2 demo flows: 1) basic gen, 2) error-triage + fallbacks. Who owns the demo scripts?
Mira Chen: @Dena I'll drop demo scripts in the thread. Alex — can you own slide deck? Jas — can you validate SSO steps?
cs-bot: Onboarding checklist updated by Mira Chen — 6 items. Reminder set for 2026-03-26T17:00:00Z.
Mira Chen: Pasting the working checklist (quick):
```
- invite: seat invites sent
- consent: signed OR opt-out recorded
- SSO: SAML enabled or token flow documented
- telemetry: opt-in confirmed (or reason)
- feedback: initial survey sent (link below)
- follow-up: enablement office hour scheduled
```
Alex P: I'll add a question to the survey: "Did you integrate via API or UI?" helps us segment usage.
Dena: Agree on the survey question. I'll draft NPS + 3 open-text follow-ups. Posting draft by EOD.
Samir: For CRM tagging, let's mark any customer without telemetry as `renewal:60` so AMs get proactive outreach. Example command for ops: `/crm tag add marigold-456 renewal:60`
Jas: Noted one pilot had spikes hitting our rate-limit at 120r/s on `/generate` — can we increase soft-limits for preview accounts or instrument 429 -> retry guidance?
Mira Chen: Good catch. Eng-runtime: can we set a soft bump for cohort A and add a quick note in onboarding about exponential backoff for 429s? @Jas I'll file a tiny follow-up ticket.
Alex P: Slide owner acked. I'll post slide link + speaker notes tomorrow.
Dena: Office hour sign-up form draft: https://forms.redwood.com/marigold-officehour — want ops to embed in invite email.
Mira Chen: Owners and actions 
- Consent template: Alex (review)
- Demo scripts: Mira
- SSO validation: Jas
- Enablement session: Dena
- CRM tagging & renewal policy: Samir
Please react with :white_check_mark: when you own it. I'll consolidate and ping AMs if anything slips.
Alex P: :white_check_mark:
Jas: :white_check_mark:
Samir: :white_check_mark:
Dena: :white_check_mark:
Mira Chen: Thanks all — will follow up with consolidated checklist and outreach copy later today.
